description:
Convert a land cover raster to vector polygons and export a specific class.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the raster layer from `/home/ga/GIS_Data/landcover_classification.tif`. This raster contains 3 pixel values: 1=Forest, 2=Water, 3=Urban.
3. Use the 'Polygonize (Raster to Vector)' tool (found in Raster > Conversion or Processing Toolbox) to convert the raster into a vector polygon layer.
4. Filter the resulting vector layer to select ONLY the Forest features (where the pixel value/DN is 1).
5. Export the selected Forest polygons to a new GeoJSON file at `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/forest_zones.geojson`. Ensure you are exporting only the selected features.
